_policy: The in-scope page set for revision 2026-07-28, with the same contract as the 2025-11-25 file: `in_scope` maps each page (as `source.section` prefixes cite it) to its published source file under docs/specification/2026-07-28/, and `cargo xtask spec-drift` enforces both directions — every listed page is cited, every cited page is listed — then verifies each quote against the published text (ADR-0010). One difference matters and is deliberate: this registry is being built AREA BY AREA, so `in_scope` grows as areas land rather than describing the whole revision from the start. `out_of_scope` therefore means what it means at 2025-11-25 — deliberately excluded, with the reason — and NOT 'not extracted yet'. Pages that are neither listed here are simply not yet entered; the complete clause inventory for the revision, quote-verified and ready to curate, is docs/reports/registry-extraction-2026-07-28-inventory-2026-08-06.md, which is the backlog. Conflating the two buckets would let unfinished work read as a scoping decision.

out_of_scope.basic/authorization/authorization-server: Full OAuth flows — the same boundary the registry's TRAN-009 exclusion records at 2025-11-25, with the suite's auth/* scenarios deferred under the `auth-client-scenarios` ledger row.

out_of_scope.client/sampling: Client-feature page, deprecated forward by SEP-2577 (register 1.5b).

_must_census_policy: Rule 1 of §What enters the registry — every MUST / MUST NOT on an in-scope page enters, no exceptions — is the strongest claim this registry makes, and until 2026-08-20 nothing enforced it. `must_census` is how many MUST-family keyword instances each page's prose carries (frontmatter and fenced code excluded; RFC 8174 makes only the uppercase instance normative). `cargo xtask spec-drift` recounts them against the published text: a reworded clause keeps the number, a clause added or removed moves it, and a move fails the gate. Re-decide it the way a deferral is re-decided — read the page, enter the new clause or retire the removed one, and update the number in the same commit. The sibling quote check proves what the registry has is still accurate; this proves the pages have gained nothing it lacks.
